QuestInfo.name: Omega Sector Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Jr. Officer Medin in the Omega Sector has an urgent request for their winter preparations.
QuestInfo.1: Jr. Officer Medin says that some key supplies for their winter operations were lost during transportation. The lost items are Jumper Inner Layers, which are used as the base layer for military jumpers... He suspects that the aliens are responsible. Defeat the aliens and recover the lost Jumper Inner Layers.
QuestInfo.2: You recovered the Jumper Inner Layers that were stolen by the aliens and delivered them to Jr. Officer Medin. Medin thanked you on behalf of the troops.

0.0: You're in Omega Sector. Be wary of frequent Alien attacks. The aliens have been targeting military supply lines lately, and they stole some Jumper Inner Layers. These were winter combat clothes prepared for soldiers and the unit will be in trouble if we don't get them back. We are currently planning a retrieval mission. Would you like to join us?
